title: Labyrinthulomycete total RNA extraction
author: Jackie Collier
materials: Allow the pellets to air dry

steps.title: Prepare Biomass
steps.instruction: Grow cells, collect, and freeze rapidly (preferably in liquid nitrogen). Store biomass at -80°C if not extracting immediately.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare all necessary buffers, reagents, and equipment for the extraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare extraction buffer containing 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1.5 M NaCl, 50 mM Na2-EDTA pH 8.0, 20 g/L CTAB (cetyltrimethylammonium bromide), and 8 mg/ml DTT (add DTT fresh just before use).
If using glass bottles for stocks, soak bottles with 0.1 M NaOH first to inactivate RNAses.
Prepare Tris-equilibrated phenol (pH 4.5-4.8) by warming to 65°C.
Prepare acid phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (pH 4.5-4.8, 125:24:1) by warming to 65°C.
Prepare 8M LiCl.
Chill 100% ethanol and 70% ethanol.
Prepare TE or nuclease-free water.
Set up an incubator at 65°C and prepare a bucket of ice.

steps.title: Suspend Biomass
steps.instruction: Suspend ~1000 micrograms wet weight biomass per ~10 ml extraction buffer by vortexing.

steps.title: Initial Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the suspension and incubate overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: First Thermal Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 65°C for 5 minutes, mixing by vortexing or inverting 2 or 3 times.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from the proteins and lipids using acid phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of hot (65°C) acid phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol and vortex to mix well.
Incubate at 65°C for 5 minutes, mixing by vortexing or inverting 2 or 3 times.
Cool the mixture on ice.
Centrifuge at 4°C, 6,000g for 15 minutes.
Move the top phase to a new tube, avoiding the interface.
If a large fluffy precipitate of DNA remains, remove it by spooling onto a glass rod.

steps.title: RNA Collection and Washing
steps.instruction: Collect the RNA precipitate and wash to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Collect precipitate by centrifugation at 4°C, 16,000g for 30 minutes (distribute among several 1.5 ml tubes if necessary and perform multiple spins).
Wash each pellet twice with 0.5 ml ice-cold 75% ethanol, centrifuging at 4°C, 16,000g for 5 minutes each time.

steps.title: Dissolution and Analysis
steps.instruction: Dissolve pellets in an appropriate volume, analyze via spectrophotometry or Bioanalyzer, and store frozen at -80°C.

steps.title: Optional: Remove Particulates
steps.instruction: If the RNA contains particulates that do not dissolve, remove them by centrifugation at 4°C, 6,000g for 5 minutes and transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Optional: DNA Removal via LiCl Precipitation
steps.instruction: If the RNA contains large amounts of DNA or other contaminants, perform selective precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 17 microliters of 8M LiCl per 50 microliters of RNA.
Incubate at -20°C for 60 minutes.
Collect RNA by centrifugation at 4°C, 16,000g for 20 minutes.
Wash each pellet twice with 0.5 ml ice-cold 75% ethanol, centrifuging at 4°C, 16,000g for 5 minutes.
Dissolve pellets in an appropriate volume, analyze via spectrophotometry or Bioanalyzer, and store frozen at -80°C.

steps.title: Final DNAse Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform a DNAse treatment step to ensure the removal of any remaining DNA, even if not obviously present.
